title: Spooks, Spirits and Speakeasy Ghost Tour
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
policies: Disclaimer: By purchasing a ticket and attending this event, all participants acknowledge and assume the inherent risks of a walking tour — including potential trips, falls, or injuries — and release Get Ghosted Phoenix LLC from any and all liability.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Experience the Spooks, Spirits, and Speakeasy Tour -a one of a kind adventure that blends history, ghostly encounters, and Phoenix nightlife. We’ll guide you through the city’s most haunted locations, where you’ll take part in ghost hunts using EMF detectors, dowsing rods, and spirit boxes.

The finale takes place inside Phoenix’s most haunted speakeasy, hidden beneath the city’s original red-light district. Guests enjoy exclusive ghost-hunting access to this Prohibition-era bar before it opens to the public. While there, you’ll also have the option to order one of their expertly crafted cocktails, known as some of the best in the city.
